title: add onboarding CLI, profile-delta comparator, and changelog release-hook
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: streamline model onboarding and make model profile changes visible and auditable. This PR introduces a small CLI to register models into the registry with validated metadata, an automated profile-delta comparator that computes token-level perf deltas between model versions, and a CI release-hook that emits human-readable changelog entries summarizing metadata/version bumps and performance regressions or gains. The goal is to reduce manual steps when adding new model artifacts and to surface regressions early during the PR/merge process. What this PR does: 1) adds scripts/onboard-cli (Python) + CLI help text and templates for metadata (name, family, architecture, quantization tags, recommended profile); 2) adds registry/profiles/diff.py to compute per-metric deltas (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory footprint) and generate a compact JSON summary plus an annotated markdown snippet for changelogs; 3) adds registry/hooks/changelog_hook.py that is invoked by the model-onboard CI workflow to append or update a changelog fragment under docs/changelogs/<model>-unreleased.md; 4) introduces gating rules in .github/workflows/model-onboard.yml: a perf-check that fails if p95 latency regression > 15% or tokens/sec drop > 10% compared to pinned baseline; 5) adds unit and integration tests under tests/ to validate comparator logic, template rendering, and hook idempotency; 6) docs/model_onboarding.md describing the end-to-end flow and manual override flags for the hook. How to review: focus on comparator thresholds and the templating output of the hook. There is a dry-run mode and an optional --force flag for ops during emergency upgrades. Backwards compatibility: the onboarding CLI writes metadata in the same top-level fields used by the registry but adds a new optional field profile_baseline_id which is ignored by older consumers. Rollout plan: merge to main, enable workflow for internal model teams for 2 weeks in feature flag dry-run mode, then flip to enforce gating. Related: builds on work in ENG-3388 (profile normalization) and the perf canary harness. Checklist: - [x] CLI and templates - [x] comparator algorithm and tests - [x] changelog hook and templating - [x] CI workflow + gating - [x] docs and examples - [x] reviewers approved
commits: feat(onboard): add onboarding CLI and metadata templates
feat(profiles): add profile delta comparator and delta schema
ci(workflows): add model-onboard workflow and perf gating
test: add unit tests for comparator and hook idempotency
docs: onboarding guide and changelog examples
review_comments: Jonah Alvarez: Overall great shape. Two requests: tighten the comparator unit tests to include edge-case noise (0ms deltas) and add a deterministic RNG seed for the synthetic profile generator used in tests.
Maya Patel: Fixed both in latest commit; added tests for zero-delta and seeded synthetic generator. See commit 'test: seed synthetic profile generator'.
Priya Desai: The gating thresholds look aggressive for some families (tiny LLMs on small GPUs). Can we expose family-specific overrides?
Maya Patel: Added mapping file templates/threshold_overrides.yaml and logic to consult family-specific thresholds; default kept as PR thresholds.
Evan Chu: CI failed on initial run because the perf-check job couldn't find baseline artifact. Suggest adding a clearer failure message and a fallback to skip gating in dry-run mode.
Maya Patel: Updated workflow: perf-check now emits a precise failure with link to expected artifact and honors dry-run flag. Re-ran CI; all checks passed.
checks: perf-check: pass (previously failed due to missing baseline; rerun after adding fallback)
release_notes: Add onboard CLI to standardize model metadata submission and introduce profile_baseline_id for optional baseline pinning.
Add profile-delta comparator to compute p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec deltas and emit structured summaries.
Add changelog release-hook to auto-generate human-readable changelog fragments including perf deltas; hook supports dry-run and --force.
CI gating: fail PRs when p95 latency regression > 15% or tokens/sec drop > 10% unless family-specific override is provided.
notes_for_ops: After merge: enable .github/workflows/model-onboard.yml for internal registry repo with DRY_RUN=true for 2 weeks.
Create baseline artifacts for existing pinned models under s3://redwood-model-profiles/baselines/ to avoid initial perf-check failures.
Ops can apply templates/threshold_overrides.yaml per family to relax gating for small LLM families.
